## What happened

Payment's `charge` path rejects **cards that expire in the current month**. Shoppers' cards expire **9/2026**, today is **2026-09-26**, so they are valid until 2026-09-30 — but payment v1.4.0 stamps them as `The credit card (ending XXXX) expired on 9/2026.` Checkout then fails PlaceOrder (gRPC 13 INTERNAL) and the shopper sees "card expired".

Decisive before/after on the **same shopper and same card** (figma-shopper-04):

| time (UTC) | payment version | result |
|---|---|---|
| 22:01:11 | **v1.3.0** | `charge` OK — `card_valid=True charged=True`, order placed |
| 22:01:40 | — | deploy **payment v1.3.0 → v1.4.0** (`6c877703f8766be0b2a9b521ec8266dc69369490`) |
| 22:01:46 | **v1.4.0** | `charge` ERROR — `The credit card (ending 1881) expired on 9/2026.` |

## Since when

- Trace evidence: first declines in the trace store at **22:01:46Z**, i.e. 6 s after the v1.4.0 deploy at 22:01:40Z; no error `charge` traces exist before that in the retained data (checked 00:00–21:31:52Z → 0 results).
- Span metrics carry an earlier snapshot of today (metric timestamps 14:50–15:28Z) where `payment v1.4.0` error spans climb 0→58 while `payment v1.3.0` stays flat at 6 — i.e. the failure tracks v1.4.0 whenever it serves traffic, consistent with the tenant's "since this morning". Note the metric snapshot's clock does not line up with the trace/deploy clock (~7 h apart), so treat the 14:50 snapshot as corroborating evidence of the version, not as a precise onset.
- No flag changes: `flag_changes` since 2026-09-26T00:00Z → 0 rows.

## Which service and version

**payment v1.4.0** (broken card-expiry comparison), surfaced through **checkout v1.4.0**. Deploy commits: `refactor: simplify card expiry comparison`, `chore(payment): give declined-charge logs a message`, `docs(payment): describe the charge rules`. Not a flag, not cart/quote/product-catalog (all healthy on their versions).

## How many shoppers affected

In the 21:31:52–22:01:52Z window:
- **Declined (4):** `figma-shopper-03` (…4242), `figma-shopper-04` (…1881), `figma-shopper-11` (…4444), `figma-shopper-12` (…5100) — all "expired on 9/2026".
- **Succeeded (2):** `figma-shopper-05`, `figma-shopper-13` (charged fine on payment v1.4.0 → their cards don't expire 9/2026).
- **No checkout traffic in window (14):** 01, 02, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 14–20 (unverifiable, not "unaffected").

So 4 of the 6 tenant shoppers that checked out were blocked; the true population is "every shopper whose card expires 9/2026" — card expiry per user is not exposed in any span attribute, so I can't enumerate the other 14.

## Evidence — two independent sources agree

**1. Traces** (`find_error_traces payment/charge` → exactly 4 hits, all 22:01:46, all `payment v1.4.0`):
```
014d4f588a25a8db7db839f0f9f0ddd9  user=figma-shopper-03  v1.4.0 charge: The credit card (ending 4242) expired on 9/2026.
fd91a4ba2bcb07f24f08a9a185a97475  user=figma-shopper-11  v1.4.0 charge: The credit card (ending 4444) expired on 9/2026.
d322ed5650c9ac4d58deab97cbdd0611  user=figma-shopper-04  v1.4.0 charge: The credit card (ending 1881) expired on 9/2026.
e6c678f6678f4e1733294d36d6839de2  user=figma-shopper-12  v1.4.0 charge: The credit card (ending 5100) expired on 9/2026.
```
In `014d4f588a25a8db7db839f0f9f0ddd9` the decline originates at `payment@v1.4.0/charge` (`demo.payment.card_valid=True` even though the charge is refused — internal contradiction in the new code) and propagates up `checkout@v1.4.0/oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge` → `checkout@v1.4.0/oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder` (user.id=figma-shopper-03) → frontend 13 INTERNAL. Control trace `7b70538a5b6ad5a9a0118b301dab4ccd` (22:01:11) is the identical flow with `payment@v1.3.0`, `charged=True`.

**2. Span metrics** — after the collector restart (21:59:55Z), only payment v1.4.0 / checkout v1.4.0 register error spans; payment v1.3.0 has zero:
- `traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="payment",service_version="v1.4.0",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}` = 8
- `...{service_name="payment",service_version="v1.3.0",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}` = 0 (17 UNSET)
- `...{service_name="checkout",service_version="v1.4.0",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}` = 8 (4 failed traces × 2 checkout error spans)
- frontend/frontend-proxy error spans = 8 / 4 — propagation only; no other service errors.

Queries run: `find_traces_for_user(checkout, figma-shopper-0N, 21:31:52–22:01:52Z)` for all 20 IDs; `find_error_traces(payment, charge)`; `get_trace(014d4f58…, fd91a4ba…, 7b70538a…, 613ff3ea…)`; PromQL `sum by (service_version,status_code) (traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="payment"|"checkout"})`; `deploys(since=2026-09-01)`; `flag_changes(since=2026-09-26)`.

## Caveats

- Logs gave **no** corroboration: index `otel-logs-2026-09-26` (133 records, all searched, plus a ≥21:30:00Z filter) contains one payment line only — `22:00:03.941Z payment v1.4.0 | info | payment gRPC server started on 0.0.0.0:50051`; searching body for `expired` and `card` returned 0 hits. So the decline message exists in spans but not in the log index. (Kafka scrape errors from otelcol-contrib are unrelated noise.)
- I did not read the payment code; another analyst should confirm the comparison in payment v1.4.0 treats `expiry_month == current_month` as expired (off-by-one: should require expiry < current month).

## Suggested fix

1. Roll **payment** back to **v1.3.0** (undo the v1.4.0 deploy, sha `6c877703f8766be0b2a9b521ec8266dc69369490`) — v1.3.0 charges the same cards successfully (figma-shopper-04 trace above).
2. Fix the expiry check so a card is valid through the **last day of its expiry month**, and re-run the same shoppers (03, 04, 11, 12) plus 05/13 as regression checks.
3. Notify the 4 confirmed shoppers; ask the tenant which of the other 16 have cards expiring 09/2026 to size the blast radius.
